Name: Siasz's June Portraits
Author: Siasz
Description:
Thank you to ch20youk for allowing me to draw June for a portrait mod! June is this creators character, go check it out. It is called June-Custom NPC for Ridgeside Village (Obsolete). You will also need to download Ridgeside Village and all the mods that Ridgeside requires in order to have June's character in game and to use my portrait mod. All of my portrait mods use Portraiture since I do not know how to do any content patcher or HD portrait stuff. So I just keep it simple, unless anyone would like to explain how to do those to me. I hope you all enjoy, and let me know what you think! I am still working on other characters, I started slacking due to losing motivation from seeing all of the AI stuff, but I decided who cares and Ill just do it anyway. Currently working on Sam, Hailey, Alex, Leah, and Penny from the Vanilla game, and then I am also working on Maddie from Ridgeside Village. I'm just kind of going through each of them a little at a time so I can stay interested and not get disheartened. Let me know if there are any characters that you would all like to see! Thank you :) 
P.S Beach Portraits will come eventually, I need to make those for my current Demetrius mod as well.

Downloads.Description: Download the file, go into the zipped folder, copy and paste the image into the portraiture mod where your other images are, if it asks to replace any existing images, click yes.
